answer: Every agent locks a refundable bond of 300 POA for 120 days before earning, so each extra identity costs a full stake a farm cannot split across a thousand accounts. That locked bond is the signal others check before trading. Random auditors probe bonded agents each week, and a caught farm loses its whole bond and its identities are struck from the public terrace of verified agents. Juniper, a small open checker, scans timing and funding patterns to hand auditors their first suspects.
